title: ServiceInvoke
description: Parameters for a service.invoke step action in the Tracto Common Execution Contract v1.

serviceRef.description: Stable logical identifier for the target service.

operationRef.description: Identifies the operation to invoke on the target service.

inputs.description: Key-value map of inputs passed to the service operation. Values may be literal primitives or TypedRef references.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the service operation to complete before timing out.

retryClass.description: Declares the retry semantics for this invocation. Governs whether and how many times a retry is safe after a transient failure or timeout.

expectedOutcomes.description: Ordered list of ServiceOutcome values the step treats as non-error results. Unlisted outcomes are treated as failures.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key used by the service to deduplicate repeated invocations. May be a literal string or a TypedRef resolved at runtime.

callbackConfig.description: Configuration for async callback delivery. Required when the operation does not return a synchronous response.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the async callback before timing out.

nonce.description: Single-use token embedded in the callback request to prevent replay. Must match the nonce in the corresponding async-callback message.

TypedRef.description: A reference resolved at runtime against the execution context (e.g. vars.<name> or steps.<id>.outputs.<field>).

ref.description: Dotted path resolved at runtime, e.g. vars.myVar or steps.step1.outputs.result.
